Index: pom.xml
===================================================================
--- pom.xml	
+++ pom.xml	
@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
+<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
+         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
+         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
+    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
+
+    <groupId>com.example</groupId>
+    <artifactId>boilerplate-free</artifactId>
+    <version>1.0.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
+    <packaging>jar</packaging>
+
+    <name>boilerplate-free</name>
+    <description>Maven Java project using Lombok to reduce boilerplate code</description>
+
+    <properties>
+        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
+        <maven.compiler.release>21</maven.compiler.release>
+        <lombok.version>1.18.48</lombok.version>
+    </properties>
+
+    <dependencies>
+        <dependency>
+            <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId>
+            <artifactId>lombok</artifactId>
+            <version>${lombok.version}</version>
+            <scope>provided</scope>
+        </dependency>
+
+        <dependency>
+            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
+            <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
+            <version>5.11.4</version>
+            <scope>test</scope>
+        </dependency>
+    </dependencies>
+
+    <build>
+        <plugins>
+            <plugin>
+                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
+                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
+                <version>3.13.0</version>
+                <configuration>
+                    <annotationProcessorPaths>
+                        <path>
+                            <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId>
+                            <artifactId>lombok</artifactId>
+                            <version>${lombok.version}</version>
+                        </path>
+                    </annotationProcessorPaths>
+                </configuration>
+            </plugin>
+
+            <plugin>
+                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
+                <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
+                <version>3.5.2</version>
+            </plugin>
+        </plugins>
+    </build>
+</project>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <groupId>com.example</groupId>
    <artifactId>boilerplate-free</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <packaging>jar</packaging>

    <name>boilerplate-free</name>
    <description>Maven Java project using Lombok to reduce boilerplate code</description>

    <properties>
        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
        <maven.compiler.release>21</maven.compiler.release>
        <lombok.version>1.18.48</lombok.version>
    </properties>

    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId>
            <artifactId>lombok</artifactId>
            <version>${lombok.version}</version>
            <scope>provided</scope>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
            <version>5.11.4</version>
            <scope>test</scope>

                    <annotationProcessorPaths>
                        <path>
                            <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId>
                            <artifactId>lombok</artifactId>
                            <version>${lombok.version}</version>
                        </path>
                    </annotationProcessorPaths>
                </configuration>

            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.5.2</version>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

parts.text:
Done. Maven + Lombok project is set up and verified (`mvn clean test` passes 2/2, app runs).

**Structure**
- `pom.xml:26` — Lombok `1.18.48` as `provided`, plus compiler plugin `annotationProcessorPaths` so it works without a standalone processor.
- `src/main/java/.../model/User.java:15` — `@Data` (getters/setters/`equals`/`hashCode`/`toString`), `@Builder`, `@NoArgsConstructor`, `@AllArgsConstructor`; `@ToString(exclude=...)` and `@EqualsAndHashCode(of="id")` tune the generated code.
- `src/main/java/.../App.java:9` — `@Log` and builder usage demo.
- `src/test/java/.../UserTest.java` — JUnit 5 tests for the generated members.

**Commands**
- `mvn test` — compile & test
- `mvn exec:java -Dexec.mainClass=com.example.boilerplatefree.App` — run demo

One note: on JDK 26 Lombok prints a harmless `sun.misc.Unsafe` deprecation warning; it compiles fine. If you'd rather avoid it (and IDE annotation processing quirks), I can pin the build to JDK 21 LTS or use Java records + `@Builder` where mutation isn't needed.
